title: Hot keys never expire: reads extend the TTL
prompt: The session cache holds entries forever under read load: an entry set with ttl=100ms and read every 90ms is still alive a minute later. The contract in lib/ttl.mjs is that an entry lives ttl ms from its SET — reads must never extend it. The clock is injectable, so write a script with a fake clock and verify expiry, size, purge, has and overwrite-restarts-ttl before answering.
